summary.text: Paul Smith is the Constitution Party candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 23A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Chris Bruce.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Christian libertarian and said it was his third run for office in Idaho.

paragraphs.text: Paul Smith earned a high school diploma from Bellarmine College Prep and graduated from the College of San Mateo in 1988, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as volunteer work and says he has been affiliated with the Marsing Emergency Network.
Smith ran for Idaho State Senate District 23 in 2024 as a Constitution Party candidate and received 4.1 percent of the vote (1,030 votes) as incumbent Todd Lakey won the general election.
The Constitution Party primary for the 2026 District 23A race was canceled.
In his 2024 survey responses, Smith listed abolishing abortion in Idaho and returning state sovereignty by ending federal funding to the state among his key messages.
